executiveSummary: The 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report' test failure rate increased from 50% to 75% after the pivot date.
One regression and two improvements were observed, with four tests remaining stable.
The increase in failure rate may indicate a timing issue related to visibility of elements.
Flaky behaviour in 'SIMS_TB_SCHOOL - XQuery Report' could reflect instability in the test environment.
These issues may affect the reliability of financial reporting for staff.
Further investigation into the regression and timing issues is recommended.
